name: Argentine Peso
oneLiner: WARS is Ripio's wrapped Argentine peso stablecoin targeting 1 WARS = 1 ARS, backed by ARS bank deposits and local-currency instruments via wFIAT.
collateral: Argentine peso reserves and local-currency liquid instruments backing WARS at a 1:1 target against the Argentine peso
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed fiat-backed stablecoin route targeting 1 WARS = 1 ARS; DefiLlama classifies the asset as fiat-backed
